messages:
tanya: Heads up — dashboards are showing a big spike for route:billing since the TS SDK 2.1.0 published the new header `x-rw-route` :eyes:. Quotas look misattributed to the fallback route.
kevin: Yep saw it earlier. The route header name changed as part of the header-casing & normalization patch. Some proxies normalized to lowercase and our attribution layer expects the old header `X-Redwood-Route`.
maria: Can confirm. Repro locally by sending `curl -H 'x-rw-route: billing'` vs `-H 'X-Redwood-Route: billing'` — backend metrics diverge.
jun: Is this just a casing problem or a full name change? Should we apply a compatibility shim in the API gateway?
oliver: It's both name + casing in some SDKs. TS 2.1 renamed to shorter header (x-rw-route) for perf/size reasons. Go and Py haven't changed names yet.
kevin: Short-term fix: accept both headers in routing policy. I can add a mapping layer in the policy router to merge `x-rw-route`, `X-Redwood-Route`, and `x-rw-routehint` into canonical `route` before quota attribution.
maria: That would fix metrics, but console UX will still show old route names in the dropdown unless we map them too. Also need to think about telemetry sampling — we risk doubling sample counts if both headers are present.
jun: Suggestion: router shim should canonicalize and drop duplicates, then emit a single telemetry tag `route_name`. Add a small metric to detect if both headers were present so we can alert on clients still sending old header.
ci-bot: build#9812 started: eng-platform/api-gateway (patch: canonicalize-route-headers)
kevin: I'll open a PR with the shim + unit tests. Plan: patch canary in prod for 2 hours on canary region (us-west-2) then rollback if any spike.
tanya: For SDK side — we need coordination. DevEx, please publish a compatibility note on the TS release page and a small patch for Py/Go to accept `x-rw-route` too.
maria: I'll add a Console migration hint showing customers any mapping we performed for the last 7 days, with link to opt-in switch to new header names in customer settings.
oliver: For release timing: TS minor already out. Py & Go will get a non-breaking patch today to accept the new header (no breaking API). We should avoid forcing a breaking change before we finish console work.
jun: Telemetry: create a temporary telemetry translation layer in the ingestion pipeline so past dashboards don't jump. We should also create a delta dashboard tile for 'route-header-mapping' so SRE can watch for misattribution.
kevin: Test plan: unit tests for header precedence, integration test exercising quota ledger mapping, load test to ensure no perf regressions when canonicalizing headers.
tanya: Ops ask: can we keep both canonicalization + a feature-flag (ff_route_header_optin) to flip to strict new-header mode after 30 days? We want a clean cutoff.
kevin: Yes — implement ff_route_header_optin in gateway flags. Default: permissive. After monitoring window, we'll flip for new customers then all.
maria: I'll coordinate Console messaging + changelog + a DevEx snippet for how to opt into the new header.
ci-bot: build#9812 succeeded: eng-platform/api-gateway (canonicalize-route-headers) :white_check_mark:
jun: After deploy, I'll run the attribution smoke tests and post the dashboard link.
tanya: Thanks all. Closing loop: kevin deploys shim canary, maria wires Console migration tile, jun validates telemetry, oliver/DevEx handle SDK patches/docs. Ping here when canary passes so we schedule ff flip.
kevin: On it. :shipit:
